candidates.change_summary: Delete the state update `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so transfers never change the recorded owner.
Replace `_ownerOf[id] = to;` with `_ownerOf[id] = from;` so ownership never moves to the recipient.
Delete the `WRONG_FROM` check so a caller can pass an incorrect `from` and still move the token, changing `_ownerOf`.
Delete the authorization require so any caller can transfer any token, changing `_ownerOf` for tokens they do not own.
Delete the `INVALID_RECIPIENT` check so transfers to address(0) succeed and burn the token's ownership record.
Delete `_ownerOf[id] = to;` in the mint override so newly minted positions have no owner, changing subsequent transferFrom behavior and ownerOf results.
Replace `_ownerOf[id] = to;` with `_ownerOf[id] = msg.sender;` so minted positions are owned by the transaction caller rather than the intended recipient.
